hints.title: Prime Node Isolation
hints.text: A valid path must contain exactly one prime number. All other nodes on the path must be composite or 1.

hints.title: Non-Prime Connected Components
hints.text: Remove all prime nodes from the tree. The remaining nodes form connected components of non-prime nodes.

hints.title: Sum of Products Around Primes
hints.text: For each prime node, find the sizes s_1, s_2, ... of adjacent non-prime components. The number of paths through this prime is sum(s_i) + sum(s_i * s_j for i < j).

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Sieve of Eratosthenes up to n followed by BFS connected components.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: All-pairs tree traversal takes O(n^2), exceeding limits for n = 100,000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary arrays for components and primes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Decompose non-prime subgraphs and aggregate paths centered on each prime.
